pins.name: VCC
pins.notes: Red wire. Needs 5 V: use VIN

pins.name: OUT
pins.notes: Yellow, blue or green wire. 0.5 V (0 pressure) to 4.5 V (full scale): use a voltage divider before the ADC

sources.title: Generic G1/4 pressure transducer seller sheet
sources.section: Supply 5 V, output 0.5 to 4.5 V, linear over the rated range (for example 0 to 1.2 MPa)
